title: Archive with an announced undo notification
prompt: Show an inbox with three messages: "Welcome to Orbit", "Your invoice is ready" and "Weekly summary". Each row has a button whose accessible name is "Archive" followed by the message title, for example "Archive Weekly summary". Archiving removes the row and shows a notification with the text "Message archived" and an "Undo" button. Screen readers must announce the notification, so it is in a live region. Undo puts the message back in its original position and hides the notification.
